CHALLENGE-01.why: each pass is a round, numbered from 1, appended after the last

CHALLENGE-02.why: every finding is judged against the aim

CHALLENGE-03.why: whoever acts on the report reads every round the same way

CHALLENGE-04.why: an empty section must say None, so silence never reads as a pass

CHALLENGE-05.why: a report keeps only what changes a decision

CHALLENGE-06.why: a deal breaker blocks only on evidence someone can re-run or re-read

CHALLENGE-07.why: a finding without its change cannot be acted on

CHALLENGE-08.why: a To decide goes to whoever owns the request, as a question
